english_outline.section_1_main_conclusion: Broadcom's fiscal Q2 2026 revenue missed consensus; AI chip guidance for Q3 also fell slightly short; shares fell over 13% after hours. Reuters attributes the drop to unmet expectations and an unchanged 2027 long-range forecast.
english_outline.section_2_core_business_changes: AI semiconductor revenue reached USD 10.8 billion, up 143% year over year, driven by custom AI accelerators and AI networking. CEO Hock Tan said Broadcom now expects to ship more than 10 gigawatts of AI chips in 2027, a slight increase, but kept the USD 100 billion long-range sales forecast unchanged.
english_outline.section_3_impact_on_growth_profit_cashfl: Total revenue grew 48% to USD 22.187 billion. Adjusted EBITDA was USD 15.244 billion, 69% of revenue. Operating cash flow was USD 10.493 billion; free cash flow was USD 10.262 billion. Q3 revenue guidance is about USD 29.4 billion, above LSEG consensus of USD 28.54 billion, but AI chip revenue guidance of USD 16 billion was slightly below Visible Alpha estimates of USD 16.36 billion.
english_outline.section_4_market_pricing_and_analyst_dis: Shares fell more than 13% in extended trading. Reuters cites Direxion's Ryan Lee saying the market demands perfection. Creative Strategies CEO Ben Bajarin said nothing slows down prior estimates, they just did not raise it. Cantor analyst commented on what went wrong with the beat-and-raise quarter. Marvell is making inroads with hyperscale customers.
english_outline.section_5_next_quarter_validation_point: The most important business validation point for Q3 is whether AI chip revenue meets the USD 16 billion guidance and whether supply chain execution supports the 2027 10-gigawatt shipment plan. Management said it is very comfortable with secured supply for 2026 and 2027.

reader_questions: 官方财报显示Q2营收221.87亿美元、同比增长48%，但路透社报道称营收低于分析师预期的222.7亿美元。这两个数字是否矛盾？应如何理解‘超预期’与‘不及预期’的差异？
公司对第三季度总营收指引约294亿美元，高于LSEG分析师平均预期285.4亿美元，但AI芯片收入指引160亿美元略低于Visible Alpha预期的163.6亿美元。市场为何更关注AI芯片指引而非总营收指引？
路透社报道股价盘后下跌超过13%，但官方财报未提供股价数据。这一跌幅是否应作为事实写入？其来源和时效性如何？
checks: 核查官方来源：Q2营收221.87亿美元，同比增长48%；AI半导体收入108亿美元，同比增长143%；调整后EBITDA 152.44亿美元，占营收69%；经营现金流104.93亿美元，资本支出2.31亿美元，自由现金流102.62亿美元；Q3总营收指引约294亿美元。路透社报道的‘营收低于预期’基于分析师预期222.7亿美元，与官方数据不矛盾，但需明确区分‘实际值’与‘预期值’。
核查路透社/Investing.com报道：Q3 AI芯片收入指引160亿美元，低于Visible Alpha预期的163.6亿美元；总营收指引294亿美元，高于LSEG预期的285.4亿美元。市场反应更多由AI芯片指引不及预期驱动，因AI业务是增长核心。
核查路透社报道：股价盘后下跌超过13%，该数据来自市场报道，非官方财报。引用时应注明来源和时效性，避免与官方财务数据混淆。
